task_objective: Resolve the open GitHub Dependabot alerts for the Vitest mock redirect path-traversal vulnerability.
design_decisions: Updated the development-only Vitest dependency from 4.1.8 to the first patched release, 4.1.11.
The lockfile now resolves both Vitest and @vitest/mocker to 4.1.11. No runtime dependency changed.
results: The frontend supply-chain audit reported no known vulnerabilities before and after the frozen-lockfile install.
Ruff check and format, ty, 1,052 Python tests with 7 skips at 90.11 percent coverage, 381 frontend tests, TypeScript typecheck, and Rollup build passed.
